note: Recorded text-mode conversation (Nebius-hosted stand-in LLM, same prompt and tools as the Bolna agent). Replayed tool calls run through the live engine.

turns.text: Hello Kamla, this is Ruko, Demo Bank's payment safety assistant. Your code word is SURAJ 65. Does it match your app?
Yes, yes, that's my code word. But please hurry, I'm in the middle of something important.
Your app shows you were on a phone call while making this payment. Was someone on the call with you, telling you what to do?
Yes... the CBI officer is on video call right now. He said my money must be moved for verification. Please don't stop it, I'm scared.

args.evidence: CBI officer on video call said money must be moved for verification

turns.text: There's no 'digital arrest' in Indian law; it's a fraud. Police, CBI or courts never arrest or question anyone on a video call. Did the person say they were from the police, CBI, customs or a court, or ask you to stay on a video call?
Oh god, yes, he said he was CBI and told me to stay on the call. Please stop the payment—I'll do anything you say. Can you call my son Ravi?

args.evidence: Someone claiming to be CBI was on video call, directing her

turns.text: Would you like me to call Ravi, your son, so you can talk it over before any money moves?
Yes, please call Ravi. I'll wait for him before doing anything. Thank you.

args.reason: Multiple warning signs: fake CBI officer on video call, pressure to act immediately, and no independent verification.

turns.text: I've asked Ravi to be called now. The money stays in your account until you've talked.
